title: 第2655章 张文渊仙界暗子第2654章 混沌初开次元位面
lines: “除非帝神子亲自出手，亦或是邪魔本源出手，才能解开诅咒。”
“苍隗留在幽冥界域已经没有任何意义了，大概率，他的本尊会回归仙界，只要他开启空间通道，诅咒秘法就能在空间中留下烙印，获取空间锚定坐标。”
轩辕烨凝声道：“这，同样也是人族进入仙界的契机！”
这，才是人族计划中极其重要的一环。
但在踏入仙界之前，还需要打通空间通道。
“现在，就该让魏凌啸他们，加紧对帝神大军的攻势了。”
苍隗的本尊原本还在闭目养神，忽然间喷出一口金色鲜血，整个人的气息瞬间萎靡下来。
“我的本命魂被摧毁了，连带着邪魔灵韵也被夺走……”
但随后，一股深深的惊惧涌上心头，那一缕本命魂与他本尊息息相关，所经历的一切也都能感知到。
“上古时代最强悍的人王，论辈分，他甚至比神主还要提前万年出生，这种怪物怎么可能还存活于世？”
紧接着又是一股深深的挫败感和无力感涌上心头。
原本，他奉帝神子之命，信誓旦旦地下界而来，准备在极短时间内掌控幽冥界域，然后趁机对人族展开攻势。
他的九道分身全部陨落，就连本命魂也遭受重创，甚至……连邪魔灵韵都被剥夺。
“再加上唐青冥……他们三人都拥有太虚境战力，若是联手起来，我就算本尊出动也不是对手。”
他深知，这场界域大战可能要提前落下帷幕了。
content_en:
"The curse can only be lifted unless the Emperor's son takes action himself, or the source of the evil spirit takes action."
"But whatever."
"There is no point for Cang Wei to stay in the Nether Realm. There is a high probability that his true self will return to the fairy world. As long as he opens the space channel, the curse secret method can leave a mark in the space and obtain the spatial anchor coordinates."
Xuanyuan Ye said in a concentrated voice: "This is also an opportunity for humans to enter the immortal world!"
Tang Ming's eyes lit up.
This is an extremely important part of the human race's plan.
Attack the fairy world.
But before stepping into the fairyland, it is necessary to open the space channel.
And Cang Wei is the key.
"Now, it's time for Wei Lingxiao and the others to step up their offensive against the Emperor God's army."
Tang Ming's eyes flashed slightly.
……
at the same time.
In a void space.
"Pfft!"
Cang Wei's true self was still closing his eyes to rest, but suddenly he spurted out a mouthful of golden blood, and his whole aura instantly became weak.
"Damn it!"
"My natural soul was destroyed, and even the evil aura was taken away..."
Cang Wei's expression was full of anger.
But then, a deep fear surged into his heart. That ray of natal soul was closely related to his true self, and he could feel everything he experienced.
But that's why.
This made Cang Wei even more frightened.
"Xuanyuan Ye!"
"The most powerful human king in ancient times. In terms of seniority, he was even born ten thousand years earlier than the Lord of Gods. How is it possible that such a monster is still alive in the world?"
Cang Wei was extremely frightened.
Immediately afterwards, a deep sense of frustration and powerlessness came to my heart.
Originally, he was ordered by the Son of the Emperor to come to the underworld, ready to take control of the Nether Realm in a very short time, and then take the opportunity to launch an offensive against the human race.
But the result?
now.
All nine of his clones fell, and even his own soul was severely damaged. Even... even the evil aura was deprived of him.
"Xuanyuan Ye, Xuanyuan Hao."
"Coupled with Tang Qingming...the three of them all possess Taixu Realm combat power. If we join forces, I will not be my opponent even if I am deployed."
"And old ghost Tian Ming..."
Cang Wei's face was gloomy.
He knew that this realm war might come to an end early.
…
Three days later.
